headline: Surat: Demand for Weekly Holiday by 1 Million Textile Workers Still Unresolved
summary: A dispute continues in Surat over weekly holidays demanded by migrant workers in embroidery and textile units. Workers say about 1 million workers have sought a weekly day off without resolution.
why: Surat is a major textile and embroidery manufacturing hub, so labour terms there affect production costs and output for the regional textile industry.
